How to Sell Digital Products on Beacons: Step by Step 1. Visit Beacons.ai and either sign up for a new account or log in if you already have one. 2. Once inside your Beacons dashboard, click on the “Create a Digital Product” option. Digital products can include eBooks, PDFs, online courses, planners, or any downloadable content. 3. On the product setup page:      - Upload an image showing your digital product you want to sell.      - Add a title, for example "Start Your Own Digital Product Business"    - Write a description for your product. You can use AI tools to help craft engaging copy if needed.      - Set the price for your product. You also have the option to offer it for free. 4. Upload the actual file, for example, PDF, zip file, or a URL). If you want to direct customers to a different platform, such as your Shopify store, copy the link to your product from Shopify and paste it here. 5. Once everything is ready, click "Publish" to make your digital product live on your Beacons page. 6. Return to your Beacons dashboard, find your newly created product, and click "Add Block" followed by "Store." In the “My Products” section, you'll see the product you’ve just created. 7. Copy the URL of your Beacons page or the direct link to your product. Share it by pasting the link in your bio on social media platforms like Instagram, TikTok, Twitter, and others. Your digital product checkout is more than a payment button. 👀 If you sell ebooks, templates, courses, guides, Canva templates, or other digital products, you need to think about what happens after someone clicks “buy.” Before selling your first digital product, make sure you have: 1️⃣ Purchase terms — what the customer is actually agreeing to when they buy. 2️⃣ License & use restrictions — what they can and cannot do with your product. 3️⃣ Privacy Policy — especially if you’re collecting customer information. 4️⃣ Website/store terms — the rules governing purchases and use of your store. 5️⃣ Protection against unauthorized sharing & reselling — because your digital product should not become the internet’s free download. 😭 Your creativity is an asset. Treat it like one. And remember: your legal protection shouldn’t start after someone steals or misuses your digital product. It should be part of your business from the beginning.
